description_en: Modifies the name and description of a custom image and manages the sharing permissions of the image
description_zh: 修改一份自定义镜像的名称和描述信息，以及管理镜像的共享权限
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone update-image-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id cpm-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateImageAttribute

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs for authorization of the shared image. The list can contain up to 10 elements
parameters.help_zh: 授权共享镜像的阿里云账号ID列表。列表最多10个元素
parameters.name: add_account

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs from which you want to remove the image sharing permissions. The list can contain up to 10 elements
parameters.help_zh: 删除镜像共享的阿里云账号ID列表。列表最多10个元素
parameters.name: remove_account

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. Default value: null, which indicates that the original name is retained
parameters.help_zh: 自定义镜像的名称。包含2~128个字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。默认值：空，表示保持原有名称不变
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the custom image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. Default value: null, which indicates that the original description is retained
parameters.help_zh: 自定义镜像的描述信息。能包含2~256个字符。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。默认值：空，表示保持原有描述信息不变
parameters.name: description
